scope: Keep the current imported solver path as the default fallback until generated PCG is stable.
Touched surfaces (per recovery plan): same as P6-1 — `solver/import_adapter.py`, solver integration layer, `algo2code` interface hook.

Concrete API (encoded in the test_p6_2 stub): `get_default_solver()` returns the imported fallback (`ScipyCGSolver`); `build_solver(mode: 'fallback' | 'generated') -> LinearSolverInterface` dispatches to the imported solver or `Algo2CodePCGSolver`; `mechdsl.solver.integration.select_linear_solver(mode)` is a thin wrapper used by Newton/external callers; default `newton_solve(linear_solver=None)` continues to resolve to `ScipyCGSolver` (already true after P6-1).
implementation_steps: Read the recovery plan section for Phase 6 (R5) and task row at line 318. Read the test_p6_2 stub for the API contract (`get_default_solver`, `build_solver`, `select_linear_solver`).

Add `get_default_solver()` and `build_solver(mode)` to `packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/solver/import_adapter.py` (purely additive — `LinearSolverInterface`, `CGSolver`, `PCGSolver`, `ScipyCGSolver`, `Algo2CodePCGSolver` MUST stay byte-identical).
Create `packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/solver/integration.py` with `select_linear_solver(mode: Literal['fallback', 'generated']) -> LinearSolverInterface` that delegates to `build_solver`.

Do NOT change Newton's `linear_solver is None -> ScipyCGSolver()` default branch. P6-2 verifies the default; it does not introduce a new selection mechanism into Newton's call site (callers still pass `linear_solver=` explicitly when opting into generated).

Replace `pytest.skip` in both test stubs with real assertions: c1 covers default-is-fallback + both modes pass regression on a small SPD system; c2 covers presence of all three surfaces + the runtime invariant that algo2code stays mechdsl-free.
Verify: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/plan_tests/recovery_plan_latex_contract/test_p6_2.py -v` 100% pass + `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_solver.py -v` 100% pass.
Update task JSON status to done after Gate C passes.
